prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: watercolor illustration for the top-right header of a one-page AI Kitchen handout.
Input image: edit target, the original title-slide illustration.
Primary request: simplify and zoom in on ONLY the carrot, tomato, and broccoli chefs cooking together around the SAME shared salad bowl. Remove the radish and eggplant completely. Remove the cutting board, pepper grinder, towels, herb pots, extra bowls, loose produce, and the wide kitchen table scene. Keep just the three smiling chefs, their chef hats, their hands collaborating at the bowl, and the one shared bowl. Their lower bodies may be naturally cropped behind the bowl, as a close-up group portrait; no full-body feet needed. A very narrow watercolor countertop immediately under the bowl is acceptable, but no surrounding table clutter.
Composition/framing: close compact landscape cluster, carrot on the left, tomato in the center, broccoli on the right, all gathered closely and participating at one bowl. Roughly 1.55:1 visible-artwork aspect ratio with minimal transparent outer padding. Keep all three hats and faces fully visible. Make their faces more prominent than in the original wide scene.
Style/invariants: preserve the exact original warm watercolor and paper-grain style, the character designs, vegetable colors, cute smiling expressions, cream chef hats, and original bowl design. Do not modernize into vector art, 3D, anime, or glossy graphics. Do not add new characters, accessories, utensils beyond the original wooden stirring spoon, text, logos, or watermark.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent background, including open space around the chefs and bowl, so the group sits directly on a cream handout without a rectangular patch.
